name: Predicate Systems (formerly SentienceAPI)
notes: Predicate Systems Inc. was formerly SentienceAPI; www.sentienceapi.com redirects to this site. It has three parts. Predicate Authority is a Rust sidecar that evaluates local YAML policies and issues signed mandates before an action executes. Predicate Runtime, with Python and TypeScript SDKs, collects element geometry through a browser extension, gives the model a structured snapshot of element IDs, roles, text, importance scores and boxes (about 0.6-1.2k tokens per step by the publisher's estimate), executes the chosen action and runs assertions such as url_contains or exists; it runs standalone with Playwright or under browser-use, and an optional Gateway reranks elements with ONNX models. predicate-secure wraps frameworks such as browser-use, Playwright and LangChain with both checks. The documentation also covers Predicate Studio traces and Predicate Vault. New accounts start with 100 free credits. Token savings, latency and reliability claims were not independently tested.
summary: Runtime trust layer for browser agents: a sidecar checks each action against local policy before it runs, and SDKs turn pages into compact ranked element snapshots and verify outcomes with DOM assertions.
